dataset: PIADv2 Unseen_aff, matching pretrained split only
cohort: 12 distinct point parents hash-ranked by image|point path; no GT-based filtering
protocol: episodic 0,1,3 updates to decoder.cmff.cross_atten1.layernorm affine only; Adam lr1e-4; two point permutations, source+view teacher mean, smooth variance weight, parameter anchor .01; final source-input readout; entropy-minimization same interface at1,3 steps, separate arm
controls: inverse-restored permutation ensemble with zero updates
scope: feasibility and paired diagnostic only, no benchmark replication or causal decoder attribution
fps_confound: Same index RNG start after permutation changes physical FPS start. Attribute sensitivity only to complete pipeline unless geometric FPS correspondence control succeeds.
label_boundary: Separate inference xyz files and scoring targets, no labels in updater, prediction seal before CPU scoring
metric_denominators: GT-defined validity masks fixed identically across arms; report per metric valid/undefined counts and all-zero/all-one target reasons; fail on any nonfinite prediction
normalization: XYZ subtract per-cloud centroid, divide maximum Euclidean norm; image RGB resize224x224 PIL default resampler then ImageNet mean/std, matching upstream
tokenizer_identity: pdelobelle/robbert-v2-dutch-base, vocabulary40000 matches checkpoint and git history; current upstream claims roberta-base vocabulary50265, identity contradiction unresolved
canonical_v2_change: Only consistency student update input changes from permuted+inverse-restored input to canonical/original input. Teacher/source/ensemble/views/LN/lr/step counts/seeds fixed. One student forward per step in both versions.
development_exposure: All canonical-v2 results use v1 development cohort after v1 task scores were exposed; no independent heldout claim.
cohort_unit_clarification: Twelve distinct point file paths and twelve distinct exact point sets, including permutation-invariant exact hashing. Independent physical object-instance provenance is not proven; pointwise bootstrap remains descriptive.
